description: This PHP class defines a ReviewerUserRole within the OrangeHRM system, handling access control related to employees, performance trackers, and logs for users with reviewer roles. It includes methods to fetch accessible entity IDs based on user permissions and role context.

classes.name: ReviewerUserRole
classes.description: Class managing reviewer user roles, providing methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns accessible entity IDs based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Fetches employee IDs the reviewer has access to if permission permits.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs accessible to the reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Gets performance tracker log IDs for the reviewer.
